t: You're looking at the Pepys Estate, a housing estate built in 1966 on the banks of the Thames, opposite the Isle of Dogs. Canary Wharf is in view from here. It is one of the largest council estates in London. It was designed by Roger Westman, an English architect who is best known for his designs of council housing in London. This estate sits squarely within that body of work, so it's a good place to see what he was known for.
